title: hearty brazilian picanha stew
description: a hearty, keto-friendly stew featuring picanha beef short ribs and melted fat, perfect for a lazy sunday dinner.
instructions: heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
add the beef short ribs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
reduce heat to medium and add the chopped onion to the pot.
cook the onion until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
add the chili powder, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper to the pot.
add the beef broth, red wine, and browned beef back to the pot.
bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
bake the stew for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender and falling off the bone.
remove the pot from the oven and sprinkle the chopped cilantro on top of the stew.
